usage: Waat6 bing1 refers to the activity of ice skating or the sport itself.
It can be used to describe the action or the sport session, like 'going waat6 bing1'.
As a noun, waat6 bing1 can function as the subject or object in a sentence.
You can use it with verbs like 'jou6' (do/play) or 'heoi3' (go) naturally.
Waat6 bing1 is often associated with winter sports or activities on ice.
